Graduate Programs
NDSU’s Physics Master’s Degree provides advanced coursework, hands-on research opportunities and close collaboration with faculty to prepare students for careers in industry, research and doctoral study. Qualified students can also pursue the Accelerated Master’s Degree option, allowing them to begin graduate coursework early and earn both bachelor’s and master’s degrees in less time.
Master's Degree & Accelerated Master's Degree
NDSU’s Physics Master’s Degree provides advanced coursework, hands-on research opportunities and close collaboration with faculty to prepare students for careers in industry, research and doctoral study. Qualified students can also pursue the Accelerated Master’s Degree option, allowing them to begin graduate coursework early and earn both bachelor’s and master’s degrees in less time.
Explore the curriclum
Doctoral Degree
NDSU’s Physics Ph.D. program offers advanced research opportunities, rigorous coursework and close mentorship from faculty experts to prepare students for careers in academia, national laboratories and industry. Students develop specialized expertise while contributing original research in a collaborative and innovative environment.
Explore the curriculum
